skill.name: Molten Shield
skill.description: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.

skill.name: Disintegrate
skill.description: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.

skill.name: Glacial Fissure
skill.description: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him. A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.

skill.name: Spiraling Despair
skill.description: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.

skill.name: WW - Pool of Reflection
skill.description:
Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.

skill.name: Pool of Reflection
skill.description:
Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.

skill.name: Slicing Maelstrom
skill.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

skill.name: Light Binding
skill.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

skill.name: Prismatic Barrier
skill.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

skill.name: Darkin Daggers
skill.description:
Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.

skill.name: Eviscerate
skill.description: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.

skill.name: Double Daggers
skill.description: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.

skill.name: Deadly Plumage
skill.description: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.

skill.name: Bladecaller
skill.description: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.

skill.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
skill.description: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.

passive.name: The Hitman and the Seer
passive.description: Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Basic Attack and Ability. Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next of the 5.

passive.name: Blaze
passive.description: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

skill.name: Hookshot
skill.description: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

passive.name: Hemorrhage
passive.description: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.

skill.name: Seastone Trident
skill.description: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.

skill.name: Quickdraw
skill.description: Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor and Magic Resist boost for several seconds. If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.

skill.name: Snip Snip!
skill.description: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

skill.name: Needlework
skill.description:
Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit.

This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

passive.name: Prophet of an Elder God
passive.description: Illaoi and the <font color='#669900'>Vessels</font> she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain. Tentacles swing at spirits, <font color='#669900'>Vessels</font>, and victims of Illaoi's Harsh lesson. Tentacles deal physical damage to enemies hit, and will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.

skill.name: Force Pulse
skill.description: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.

skill.name: Radiant Blast
skill.description: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.

skill.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
skill.description:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.
Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

skill.name: Bramble Smash
skill.description: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

skill.name: Savagery
skill.description:
Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.

Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.

skill.name: The Equalizer
skill.description: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

skill.name: Realm Warp
skill.description:
Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux.

On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.

skill.name: Flair
skill.description: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

skill.name: Inferno Trigger
skill.description: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.

skill.name: Piercing Darkness
skill.description: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.

skill.name: Last Embrace
skill.description: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.

skill.name: Vision of Empire
skill.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

skill.name: Demonic Ascension
skill.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

skill.name: Force of Will
skill.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

skill.name: Unleashed Power
skill.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

skill.name: Toxic Shot
skill.description: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

skill.name: Wilding Claw
skill.description: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.

skill.name: Iron Mantle
skill.description: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.

skill.name: Stretching Strikes
skill.description: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.

skill.name: Let's Bounce!
skill.description: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.
